basis_requirements.meaning: Use one-forms alpha with delta alpha = 0; exact gradients are excluded from the physical determinant domain.
For the convention used in prior tower audits, shell n has lambda=(n+1)^2 and rho=n+1.
The two transverse families together have multiplicity 2 n (n+2).
For L(2,1)=S3/{±1}, prior audits keep odd n and project out even n.
Eigenforms must be orthonormal on L(2,1), not inherited with S3 volume normalization by accident.

missing_matrix_data.needed: <n,i | delta_A Delta_1 | m,j> for coexact L(2,1) vector harmonics and A in Sym^2(R4)
missing_matrix_data.why: Without these entries the mixed trace cannot be evaluated.

missing_matrix_data.needed: Projection of delta_A Delta_1 alpha back to the coexact slice
missing_matrix_data.why: Metric variation can mix representative components unless the physical slice is handled explicitly.

missing_matrix_data.needed: Which shell pairs (n,m) are connected by a quadratic ambient deformation
missing_matrix_data.why: This decides whether the trace collapses to P02 or spreads over the tower.

missing_matrix_data.needed: Integrals of products of two vector harmonics and one quadratic strain over L(2,1)
missing_matrix_data.why: These integrals are the actual coefficients in the trace-square.

first_shell_diagnostic.diagnostic: The first surviving coexact shell has degeneracy 6, not 10. Therefore the desired P02 rank 10 cannot be read off from the first coexact eigenvalue multiplicity. It must arise from the deformation space Sym^2(R4), or it does not arise at all.

route_tests.reason: First kept coexact shell has multiplicity 6; cumulative kept multiplicities are 6, 36, 106, ... not 10.
Sym^2(R4) has dimension 10, so rank 10 can only come from summing over allowed first metric deformations, not from counting coexact modes.
The L(2,1) projection removes even n but leaves infinitely many odd n shells.
A finite P02 answer must follow from matrix elements and selection rules, not from replacing the tower by rank 10 by declaration.

verdict: The L(2,1) coexact basis layer is now fixed at the shell-counting level: odd n shells survive with degeneracy 2n(n+2), even n shells are projected out. This immediately shows that rank 10 is not an eigenmode multiplicity: the first surviving coexact shell has degeneracy 6 and the tower remains infinite. Therefore C6 can only be saved if the mixed trace over metric deformations Sym^2(R4) collapses to P02 through explicit matrix elements. The next missing data are the integrals <n,i|delta_A Delta_1|m,j>.
